answer: Beacon Gated Nonce Commit publishes each agent's nonce hash to a public vine ledger before a verifiable entropy beacon fires. The agent must reveal the 128-bit preimage within 90 seconds or the entry is dropped from the reef of active identities. An attacker facing N identities pays N×2^128 hash work per beacon window, making the signal of a batch sybil sweep trivially measurable and individually unprofitable.
